fullExplanation.text: Understanding What Counts as a New Religious Movement

Within New Religious Movements, the question What Counts as a New Religious Movement? must be answered at the right level of authority. Examines restorationist, esoteric, syncretic, high-control, and new revelation movements using their official sources and careful pastoral distinctions. Scripture, ecclesial teaching, historical testimony, and specialist research contribute different kinds of evidence. The lesson therefore identifies which source establishes each premise and labels every interpretive step rather than presenting a synthesis as though it were a direct quotation.
